title: Remove product listing grid section from homepage

requirements.summary: Remove the multi-row product listing grid section showing product cards with category labels, prices, and delivery times from the homepage while preserving all other sections
acceptanceCriteria: The multi-row product listing grid shown in the uploaded screenshot (image-13.png) no longer appears anywhere on the homepage.
No product cards with category labels, prices in the format shown (e.g., '₹249', '₹499'), and delivery time text (e.g., '5-7 business days') from that grid section are rendered on the homepage.

All other homepage sections remain visible and fully functional: hero banner, product category grid, featured products, shop frames by size, offers banner, trust features, customer reviews, FAQ section, and footer.
No JavaScript errors or broken layout appear after the removal.

file_operations.description: Remove the specific product listing grid section that displays product cards in a multi-row grid format with category labels, prices (₹249, ₹499, etc.), and delivery times. Based on the file summary, HomePage conditionally renders search results, category-filtered products, or the full homepage with multiple sections. Identify and remove only the product listing grid component/section that matches the screenshot (image-13.png) showing items like 'Digital Printed Notebook', 'Digital Wall Art', 'Poster Collage with Photo', etc. Preserve all other sections: HeroBanner, ProductCategoryGrid, FeaturedProducts, ShopFramesBySize, OffersBanner, TrustFeatures, CustomerReviews, FAQSection, and Footer. Ensure the removal does not break the layout or introduce console errors.
